summary_en: Ship Healthcare Holdings launched a tender offer for Charm Care Corporation at 1,970 yen per share, with a minimum purchase of 12,194,500 shares representing 66.73% of voting rights. The offer period runs from November 9 to December 21, 2026. Charm Care's board supports the offer and recommends shareholders to tender.
title_en: Notice of Commencement of Tender Offer for Charm Care Corporation (Security Code: 6062)
translation_en_brief:
Ship Healthcare Holdings, Inc. announced on November 6, 2026, that its board of directors has resolved to acquire all shares of Charm Care Corporation (code 6062, listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market) through a tender offer for the purpose of making it a wholly owned subsidiary. The tender offer will run for 30 business days from November 9 through December 21, 2026.

The acquisition price is set at 1,970 yen per common share. The minimum number of shares the company plans to acquire is 12,194,500 shares. Upon acquisition of this minimum number, Ship Healthcare's ownership stake (calculated as voting rights owned by the acquirer plus those of specially related parties) will reach 66.73% based on the 326,624 voting rights as of June 30, 2026, disclosed in Charm Care's 42nd securities report filed on September 28, 2026. Additionally, Stock option warrants issued under Charm Care's equity incentive plans (stock compensation type) will be acquired for 1 yen each per unit.

Charm Care's board of directors has expressed support for the tender offer and recommended that shareholders tender their shares. For holders of stock options, the board has stated that the decision to tender remains at their discretion. No upper limit has been set for the number of shares to be acquired.
